about.bio: I am a Senior QA Analyst with experience testing web applications, mobile apps and APIs in financial services. I have worked at ITAE / Solar Banco since September 2024, with previous development experience in Oracle APEX, PL/SQL and JavaScript. I integrate automation and AI into the QA workflow.
about.problemsSolved: I connect test cases, execution and evidence to Jira issues. I use Playwright for web applications and Postman for APIs, comparing data and consulting Swagger specifications when needed.
about.engineeringApproach: I use Rovo to generate test cases and Codex to execute Playwright specifications and prepare Postman collections. I integrate these workflows through MCP, generate PDF evidence and record results in Jira. I also created a runner to execute tests in GitLab.
